text: Via the ___ correspondence, natural-deduction proofs correspond to programs (typed λ-terms) and propositions correspond to types.
explanation: This is the Curry–Howard correspondence (proofs-as-programs, propositions-as-types): intuitionistic natural deduction corresponds to the simply typed λ-calculus. Identified by Howard (1969), it is the theoretical basis of proof assistants such as Lean 4 and Coq.
